verdict.rationale: API-to-UI parity is a fair question for a SaaS code-hosting platform, but the evidence pack never documents a Bitbucket REST API or its coverage, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. The vague line about building custom integrations and the existence of an Atlassian MCP server are adjacent capabilities; neither shows that everything in the UI is available through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
